environment.description: Same application deployed on a GKE Autopilot cluster with a custom seccomp profile applied via the pod's security context (localhostProfile: profiles/document-svc-restricted.json). The profile operates in SCMP_ACT_ERRNO mode for syscalls outside the allowlist. The allowlist permits read, write, open, openat, close, fstat, stat, lstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, ioctl, access, pipe, select, sched_yield, mremap, dup, dup2, nanosleep, getpid, clone, uname, fcntl, ftruncate, getcwd, chdir, rename, mkdir, rmdir, link, unlink, readlink, chmod, fchmod, chown, lchown, getuid, getgid, geteuid, getegid, getppid, getpgrp, setsid, getgroups, setgroups, epoll_create, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, futex, set_tid_address, clock_gettime, exit_group, set_robust_list, eventfd2, epoll_create1, pipe2, getrandom, prlimit64, arch_prctl, newfstatat, close_range, rseq — but explicitly DENIES execve, execveat, ptrace, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev, socket, connect, bind, listen, accept, sendto, recvfrom, sendmsg, recvmsg, socketpair, setsockopt, getsockopt. Additionally the container runs as non-root (uid 1001, gid 1001) with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, and the /app/data/extracted path is backed by an emptyDir volume with a 512Mi sizeLimit. A PodSecurityPolicy (restricted) enforces allowedHostPaths: none, and drops ALL capabilities.

config.seccomp_profile: localhostProfile: profiles/document-svc-restricted.json (SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for execve, execveat, ptrace, socket, connect, bind, listen, accept, sendto, recvfrom, sendmsg, recvmsg, socketpair, process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev)
config.pod_security: restricted PSP, no hostPath mounts, runAsNonRoot: true
config.network_policy: egress denied except DNS (UDP 53) to kube-dns
